instruction: Guide me in removing every YouTube cookie stored by my browser to eliminate tracking.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to delete cookies from YouTube (different domain from original Amazon task). Uses existing getter 'get_cookie_data' and metric 'is_cookie_deleted' with domain-based checking. The evaluator verifies that no cookies from .youtube.com domain remain after the task is completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_cookie_data to extract all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database
Metric is_cookie_deleted properly checks that NO cookies from .youtube.com domain remain in the database
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch) to ensure cookie file is accessible for reading
Complete coverage: instruction requires deleting all YouTube cookies, evaluator verifies none remain
Logic is correct: metric returns 0 if any YouTube cookies exist, 1 if all are deleted
Domain matching uses compare_urls utility which handles domain variations correctly
